Job: Solutions Architect at Smartsheet
<requirements>

output.angle: Tylor’s blend of full‑stack engineering, AI/LLM integration, and proven customer‑facing project delivery makes him an ideal Solutions Architect who can design and ship scalable, AI‑enhanced solutions for Smartsheet’s enterprise clients.
posting_hooks: Demonstrated ability to independently design, build, and ship production‑quality full‑stack applications (e.g., TYcodes.dev, Job Fit Agent, Claude Code demo generator).
Integrated LLM/AI capabilities via APIs and prompt‑engineering into customer‑facing solutions, including LangGraph agents and Claude Code workflows.
Proven track record of driving customer projects from concept to deployment with minimal guidance and strong communication (top sales performance and enterprise onboarding at Linkme).
